source_metadata.title: American Society of Hematology 2026 Guidelines for Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP): Initial and Second-Line Therapy in Adults with Primary ITP

duplicate_review.finding: No exact duplicate canonical statements or duplicate source-anchor/statement pairs detected across semantic batches.

consistency_review.finding: Direct and indirect evidence, different populations, and different timepoints were retained as distinct atoms rather than merged.

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind. Guideline recommendations were encoded as author_conclusion (and good-practice statements as other) with descriptive tags, per the large-source guideline guardrail.
Quantitative atoms summarize results as reported by the guideline; they are tagged secondary_reported_result and do not imply that the guideline itself enrolled participants or generated those data.
extraction_limitations: The retrieved source is a guideline rather than primary literature, while the current atom schema is optimized for primary literature.
Supplements 2-8 were referenced but not present in the retrieved Drive folder/PDF, so supplement-only details were not extracted.

The evaluated PDF is marked DRAFT – PLEASE DO NOT DISTRIBUTE OR CITE and dated 7/27/2026; the DOI/title are current 2026 publication identifiers, but wording should be checked against the final publisher version before formal citation or practice implementation if this draft differs.
References were used to create a task queue, not treated as evidence atoms.
